name: p11
description: Create, reply to, and revise shareable p11 documents from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Share, reply to, and revise p11 documents.
interface.longDescription: Use p11 from Codex to create shareable, commentable documents, reply to visible review comments that need clarification, and revise existing p11 documents from clear reviewer decisions.
defaultPrompt: Use p11:share to create a shareable document from this.
Use p11:reply to answer visible comments that need clarification on this p11 document.
Use p11:revise to apply clear comments and share a new version.
